We recommend, before booking a group of driving lessons, that you take an hour with your chosen Driving School Instructor and make sure you are happy with the tuition and confident that this Instructor suits you - then you can book a group of lessons.
Remember you MUST produce your Learner Permit on your first lesson, and indeed should carry it with you all the time.
Read up well on your Rules of the Road before your first lesson.
Driving lessons are a serious matter, however we will always make students feel at ease and make the experience as stress free and pleasant as possible.

If you have a particular time in the week that suits you pre-book these times with the instructor.
Driving lessons will start from Westside Shopping Centre unless otherwise arranged with the Instructor.
The test-routes from Westside, Galway will be covered in driving lessons
Our pre-test pass rate is one of the highest in Galway.
All courses available from Learn to Drive Galway:

As of 4th April 2011, you must undertake the Essential Driver Training (EDT) before you can take the driving test. The driving trainer course of 12 lessons can only be taken with a qualified Instructor or ADI. The course is designed to cover the critical driving skills.
Changing Direction (More complex situations)
After each EDT lesson the Driving Instructor will stamp the appropriate page of your logbook and give feedback on the lesson.
Remember EDT is only part of learning to drive and students will need, on the road practice, and most will require more than the 12 lessons on the EDT course.

As we all know the volume of traffic around Galway (and indeed all Irish cities) has increased dramatically over the last number of years. We offer a refresher course to people who, for various reasons, are nervous about driving in the city.
New residents in the city, who would like to become familiar with roundabouts – e.g. Galway Shopping Centre Roundabout and gain a familiarity with driving in the city.
People who may not have had the need to drive regularly in the city and would like just a little encouragement to help them contend with increased volume
Remember a confidenence in knowing the proper driving procedures increases your competence and safety on the roads, and the best route to knowing these procedures is through a trained instructor.
Everyone whether a beginner or long time driver should familiarise themselves with the Rules of the Road
